task: Open {{base}}/deals and tell me the price of the Phone in the table.
script: const p = await browser.openTab(base + '/deals'); const rows = await p.table('table'); const facts = rows.find((row) => row.some((cell) => String(cell).includes('Phone'))); ({ facts: { price: facts[1] }, steps: ['open /deals', 'read the table'] })

fixture.agent: The Phone costs 699 in the table on the deals page.

task: Open {{base}}/virtual and tell me what job 120 says. The list draws only what is on screen.
script: const p = await browser.openTab(base + '/virtual'); const rows = await p.list('[data-index]'); const row = rows.find((text) => text.includes('Job 120')); ({ facts: { row }, steps: ['open /virtual', 'list every row'] })

fixture.agent: Job 120 says: Job 120 Yet to apply.

task: Open {{base}}/form, apply as Ada (ada@example.com), and tell me the confirmation text.
script: const p = await browser.openTab(base + '/form'); await p.locator('input[name=name]').fill('Ada'); await p.locator('input[name=email]').fill('ada@example.com'); await p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send' }).click(); const result = await p.locator('#result').innerText(); ({ facts: { confirmation: result }, steps: ['open /form', 'fill the fields', 'submit'] })
